label: Pueblo
_note: Matches Shadowrun's Pueblo Corporate Council. Names here are a small subset of real, documented Hopi names (one of several distinct Pueblo peoples) from Henry Voth's 1905 ethnographic monograph 'Hopi Proper Names' (archive.org). That source organizes names by clan/totem, is OCR-scanned (spellings may have errors), and reflects one outside missionary's documentation from over a century ago — treat this as a small respectfully-sourced starting set, not a complete or definitive list. No lastNames: traditional Hopi naming doesn't use Western-style surnames.
